messages:
alex: Pager bot just paged for /v1/chat/completions p99 in prod; 5m window showing 4.2s. I'm taking initial triage and paging now.

pagerbot: INCIDENT #1934567890: latency.p99.chat_completions.prod exceeded threshold (4.2s) — pages: oncall

morgan: seeing the spike concentrated on model=mammoth-13b, route=/user/reply. p95 nudged but p99 is the big outlier. sudden traffic bump from a third-party webhook?

irene: trace attached: https://grafana.company/trace/abcd — looks like tail latencies correlate with very long prompt sequences and token-limit bursts. KV cache churn appears high.

alex: mitigation attempt 1: rerouting heavy /user/reply traffic to mammoth-7b-quant (smaller model group) via routing-policy for the next 10m. rolling now.

sam: applying a temporary soft rate-limit on /user/reply at 5rps/org for 10m to reduce KV pressure. pushing config change.

alex: both changes pushed. monitoring p99, p95, and error counts.

morgan: quick update: mammoth-13b p99 dropped 4.2s -> 2.1s after routing change. overall service p99 down to ~1.9s. no uptick in 5xx.

irene: customer impact: only 3 orgs show elevated latencies in logs, most customers unaffected. noted impacted org ids in the incident doc.

alex: handing to @morgan for the next hour — stepping away briefly. leave anything urgent here; escalate to SRE lead if it resurfaces.

incbot: Handoff recorded: alex -> morgan (duration: 60m) at 1934568000

morgan: acknowledged. I'll keep the rotation message up and alert if it reoccurs.

sam: after-action thought: our global p99 alert (4s) is too broad. it mixes small quant models and massive LLMs. propose we split alerts by model-size-group and by route criticality.

irene: +1. propose baseline per-model-group targets: small p95<300ms p99<800ms; mid p95<600ms p99<1200ms; large p95<900ms p99<2500ms. also separate thresholds for premium routes vs background routes.

morgan: also add a minimal-volume guard so we don't page on tiny bursts. suggestion: affected_request_count > 50 over 5m before firing.

sam: draft alert expression (example):
```
alert: high_latency_chat_completions
expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, latency_ms{endpoint="chat.completions", model_group=~"mammoth.*"}[5m]) > 2500 and sum_over_time(request_count[5m]) > 50
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: sev2
  team: eng-oncall
```
We can parametrize model_group and thresholds via templated alert rules.

alex: add exclusions for canary and replay traffic too — those have been noisy during deploy windows.

irene: dashboard items to add: per-route latency heatmap, model-group p95/p99 timeseries, request-count heatmap, and a mitigation-burn-down chart showing the effect of routing/rate-limit.

morgan: filing a ticket to implement rules and dashboards: ENG-ALERTS-451. content includes rule variants, dashboards, and runbook updates.

sam: runbook edits: explicit mitigations list — reroute to cheaper model group, apply soft rate-limits, increase autoscale buffers, and failover to cached responses when applicable. also indicate when to escalate to infra.

alex: post-incident actions: rationalize default p99 thresholds, add per-route criticality tags in request logs so alerts can filter, and schedule a follow-up with product to label SLO-critical routes.

incbot: Incident #1934567890 status changed to: RESOLVED — mitigation stable, metrics within temporary thresholds. closed at 1934568430

morgan: FYI I temporarily relaxed the global p99 sensitivity while we roll out the model-group split. will open a PR with the new rule set and dashboard mocks.

sam: :thumbsup: starting the PR now, will link once ready.

alex: thanks team — summary: handoff done, routing + soft rate-limit applied, follow-ups created (ENG-ALERTS-451), next steps: per-model/per-route thresholds, dashboards, and runbook updates.
